newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ARGENTINA'S MENDEZ SIGNS WITH BATH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ARGENTINA'S MENDEZ SIGNS WITH BATH.

text.p: Argentine international Federico Mendez on Friday joined English rugby union champions Bath from South African provincial side Natal.
Director of rugby John Hall said Mendez, who can play both at prop and hooker, would join the club in the near future.
Mendez has been selected to tour England with the Pumas later this month but says he will not travel in protest at "archaic" amateur attitudes towards professional rugby in Argentina.
